data.title: General Meeting Planning Committee - Planning Call

event_sessions.title: General Meeting Planning Committee - Planning Call

data.description:
Join the General Meeting Planning Committee to help plan Boston DSA's General Meetings and General Organizing Meetings! No experience is required, and all skillsets are welcome--many hands make light work, and we need all sorts of hands, from the most gregarious extroverts to the most introverted computer goblins. Still unsure of joining? There are many small tasks with little to no commitments needed make it all happen every month. :) RSVP for the link to the agenda and Zoom call!
What is a General Meeting? A General Meeting is a meeting of the chapter's General Membership, its highest decision-making body. General Meetings are where the General Membership comes together deliberate and make decisions democratically and collectively, as well as to catch up on our ongoing work (and learn how to plug into it), skill-share, and engage in political education.
What are General Organizing Meetings? General Organizing Meetings are also all-chapter meetings, but their focus is primarily on implementing our decisions once we've made them. Time at these meetings is primarily dedicated to training, skill-sharing, and political education, and, when possible, active organizing tasks. 
What is the General Meeting Planning Committee? The GMPC primarily a logistical event planning body, and is responsible for booking venues, recruiting volunteers, liaising with the Coordinating Committee and Internal Elections, and taking on any other meeting-related support tasks that the Coordinating Committee wishes to delegate. The Coordinating Committee is the final authority on GM/GOM agendas, although the GMPC can coordinate with you on developing and presenting your agenda item if the CC approves it.

data.title: Support Sex Workers at Cambridge City Council

event_sessions.title: Support Sex Workers at Cambridge City Council

data.description:
Join BDSA and BSWAC to support sex workers at Cambridge city council. A proposal cosponsored by our very own Socialist in Office Jivan Sobrinho-Wheeler aims to begin decriminalizing sex work in Cambridge and providing protections for workers in the industry. Read the proposal here. Decriminalization of consensual sex work is proven to improve conditions for workers and increase safety for those experiencing coercion.
We'll be meeting outside city hall at 5 pm before the meeting starts at 5:30. It is expected to last several hours and you are welcome to come late or leave early. Wear red or pink to show your support!
Visit https://bswac.org/ to learn more and find other ways to support, including giving testimony at the meeting.

data.title: Sex Workers Support Casino Workers
data.description:
Boston Sex Workers and Allies Collective is showing up for striking workers at Encore Casino! Join BSWAC and BDSA on the line with Teamsters Local 25 and Unite Here Local 26.
Workers at Encore are on strike until they get a fair contract. Wynn Casinos makes $2 million dollars a day at Encore, but when workers demanded a ten dollar raise the company offered fifteen cents. Workers in both unions are striking together, picketing 24 hours a day until they get what they deserve.
Sex workers and allies are showing solidarity by coming out to do some late night picketing. Boston DSA will be there to support all the workers!

Learn more about the strike here:
https://www.local26.org/encore/

Learn more about BSWAC here:
https://bswac.org/

data.title: Labor Circle
data.description:
The Labor Circle is a monthly discussion-based meeting for those of us who are organizing our workplaces or are interested in doing so. We welcome both workers trying to start a new unions and union members doing rank and file organizing. Come share your struggles and successes in bringing your coworkers to action and provide and be provided guidance and support. There is no agenda, although experienced organizers will be present to help facilitate discussion as needed.
No one turned away for lack of experience!
